label: UI / Frontend
journeys: Open the affected screen, complete its primary action, and recover from invalid input

checks.reason: Changed UI can alter navigation and form interaction.
checks.expected: Configured interaction assertions pass, including invalid input and keyboard navigation.

checks.reason: Style changes need automated layout, accessibility, and visual evidence at configured viewport sizes.
checks.expected: Configured browser checks pass without layout overflow, broken assets, or detected accessibility violations; the AI reviewer receives revision-bound screenshots when enabled.
checks.requirement: Trusted browser suite and target application's UI acceptance specifications

label: Backend / API
journeys: Submit valid input, reject invalid input, and handle dependency failure

checks.reason: Endpoint changes can affect response contracts and error handling.
checks.expected: Configured contract, input-validation, and dependency-failure assertions pass.

label: Authentication
journeys: Log in, access an allowed resource, deny a forbidden resource, expire the session, and log out

checks.reason: Authentication or authorization changes can affect access boundaries.
checks.expected: Configured valid-login, invalid-login, expired-session, allowed-role, and denied-role assertions pass.
checks.requirement: Target application's authentication and role policy

label: Payments / Billing
journeys: Calculate a total, complete synthetic checkout, handle a decline, and retry without duplicate charges

checks.reason: Payment logic requires deterministic synthetic regression coverage.
checks.expected: Configured amount, decline, duplicate-request, and refund assertions pass using synthetic data.

label: Database
journeys: Migrate disposable synthetic data, read and write it, and validate the supported rollback behavior

checks.reason: Schema changes may affect data integrity and existing queries.
checks.expected: Configured migration, read/write, integrity, and supported rollback assertions pass in a disposable environment.

label: Deployment / Infra
journeys: Start the application in an isolated environment and exercise its health endpoint

checks.reason: Deployment changes can prevent startup or readiness.
checks.expected: Configured startup and readiness assertions pass without production credentials.

label: Test suite
journeys: Run the changed assertions and essential regression suite
